## 4. Data Privacy and Security

4.1 **Local Storage**: The Software stores all data locally on the Licensee's device. Licensor does not collect, store, or transmit Licensee's vault data, passwords, keys, or personal information to any external servers.

4.2 **Encryption**: The Software uses strong cryptographic algorithms (AES-256-GCM, Argon2id, etc.) to protect data at the application layer. However, Licensee is responsible for securing their device and master password.

4.2.3 **Master Password Responsibility**: Licensee acknowledges that:
- The master password is the only way to access the vault;
- There is no way for Licensor to recover lost master passwords;
- Loss of the master password will result in permanent and irrevocable loss of all data stored in the vault;
- The recovery key must be stored securely and is the only alternative in case of master password loss.

4.3 **Audit Logs**: The Software may record security events locally in an audit log. These logs remain on Licensee's device and are not transmitted externally.
